summary: Phase 2 auth + RBAC tested end-to-end. Backend: 15/15 pytest cases passing (login success/wrong-pw/disabled/invited, /auth/me 401, /admin 401 unauth + 403 for agent, invite→accept→login, admin reset-password token flow, agent toggle disable/enable, logout, self-service change-password, brute-force lockout returns 429 after 5 fails). Frontend: full browser flow passes on the public URL — admin login lands on /admin, wrong password shows visible error, /admin/agents Invite dialog issues invite URL with Copy button, /accept-invite sets a new password (mismatch validated) and redirects to /login, new agent logs in and lands on /agent, /admin as agent redirects to /forbidden, logout clears cookies and refresh of /agent redirects to /login. No functional bugs discovered.
critical_code_review_comments: auth_service.login has a dead expression `await _check_and_bump_lockout(identifier, success=True) if False else None` on line 94 — noise, remove.
admin_users.py imports `user_random` from within the module at bottom (defined after use). Works because Python resolves at call time, but move helper to core/security.py for clarity.

invite flow returns raw invite_token in JSON response — acceptable for MVP where admin manually shares the link, but ensure this is never logged/audited with the raw token; audit_log correctly only stores agent_id — good.
Toggle-status flip on the demo agent by the test suite is avoided (fresh agents created), but there is no rate-limit on invite creation — consider capping per-admin.
SetPasswordPage validates `password.length < 8` client-side but the backend Pydantic also enforces min_length=8 — good defence-in-depth.
test_credentials: Admin yongmichael992@gmail.com / Admin@12345 and demo agent agent.demo@biyahetabai.example.com / Agent@12345 both work as documented.
seed_data_creation: Several TEST_*@example.com agent accounts created during backend + UI tests. They are active in DB and will accumulate if suite is re-run repeatedly; consider a periodic cleanup script.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_auth_rbac.py is the canonical Phase 2 regression suite. It uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from env. Brute-force test intentionally exhausts 5+ attempts on a fresh email to avoid tripping the lockout for the real admin/demo agent. The suite creates fresh TEST_*@example.com agents per test to keep tests independent.
